name: nova-lumina
description: Nova-Lumina astronomy learning and exploration monorepo

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run provider-scheduler:check && pnpm run api:check && pnpm run package:check && pnpm run manifests:check && pnpm run catalog:artifact-check && pnpm run sky-context:artifact-check && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run migrations:check
scripts.catalog:artifact-check: uv run nova-lumina-catalog ingest --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-photometry-v1 --validate-only && uv run nova-lumina-catalog ingest --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-astrometry-v1 --validate-only && uv run nova-lumina-catalog ingest --slice simbad-messier-j2000-v2 --validate-only
scripts.catalog:data-check: uv run nova-lumina-catalog data-check --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-photometry-v1 && uv run nova-lumina-catalog data-check --slice gaia-dr3-exoplanet-host-astrometry-v1 && uv run nova-lumina-catalog data-check --slice simbad-messier-j2000-v2
